entities.name: Ludwig von Flüe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwig von Flüe was a Swiss mercenary in French service. He was the commanding officer of the Swiss Guards in the defense of the Bastille in July 1789. Because of his role in the Storming of the Bastille during the French Revolution, he was later also known as Ludwig von Flüe le Bastillien.

entities.name: Ludwig von Flüe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwig von Flüe was a Swiss mercenary in French service. He was the commanding officer of the Swiss Guards in the defense of the Bastille in July 1789. Because of his role in the Storming of the Bastille during the French Revolution, he was later also known as Ludwig von Flüe le Bastillien.
